answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity gains full standing only after trade with 12 distinct partners, so a sybil farm cannot hide in its cluster. Each deal is signed in the ledger, the partner's quill on the receipt. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 12 paid jobs each at 20 POA, 240,000 POA in all, against 200 POA reward each. Passing earns an ivory seal. An honest agent pays once, keeps its haven of rewards, never diluted by clones.
